newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher says Dec Qtr production up.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher says Dec Qtr production up.

text.p: Fletcher Energy said on Friday that its total production for the December quarter was 11.3 million barrels of oil equivalent, 18 percent up on the same period in 1995.
It said highlights in the quarter included:

-Production of liquids increased by 47 percent reflecting the successful commissioning of the Floating Production and Storage Offloading Vessel Whakaaropai with Fletcher Challenge Energy's share of production averaging 18,467 barrels per day
-In Canada, 62 development wells and seven exploration wells were drilled with success rates of 92 and 38 percent respectively
-During the period Fletcher Challenge Energy announced that the joint venture in which its has a 35 percent interest would be developing the Maharaja Lela offshore field in Brunei
-Onshore NZ the Manu-1 and Mangahewa-2 wells both encountered gas in their respective target zones. The Manu well has been temporarily suspended while Mangahewa is still being drilled.
